verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents RBAC for fine-grained access management, environment-scoped API keys (public client-side vs private server-side), and an official MCP server that gives agents programmatic access to the Admin API — the building blocks for scoping an agent's credentials exist. However, there is no explicit documentation of creating a dedicated least-privilege/scoped token specifically for an AI agent (e.g., a restricted MCP-server API key or agent-specific role), so this is inferred from general RBAC/API-key capabilities rather than an agent-specific workflow. Missing for 10: explicit docs on issuing a scoped/limited-permission API key or role specifically for agent/MCP use, and any guidance on restricting MCP server API access to a subset of resources.
